rows.about:
Root covers the entire input; InfoDiagram runs from its first retained
pre-heade

judgment.note: In info/lex-comment-ls-bridge, showInfo at [14,22] is the unmarked continuation of the native comment, not a flag unit. Remove the unmarked Comment at [14,22], add a Keyword token with value showInfo at [14,22] and loc {start:{line:2,column:0},end:{line:2,column:8}}, set InfoDiagram.showInfo from false to true, and extend InfoDiagram.range from [0,4] to [0,22] with loc {start:{line:1,column:0},end:{line:2,column:8}}. checkTree() returned []. The diagram range now includes the native comment continuation instead of ending at its last written header/flag/body form. The other cases are reported in check-tree-shared-positions.test.ts: Root covers the whole input ("fails an info root that ends before the end of the input"); the first retained pre-header YAML or directive starts the diagram ("fails an info diagram that starts at its header after retained YAML", "fails an info diagram that starts at its header after a retained directive"); without a retained form the header starts it ("fails an info diagram that starts after the first character of its header"); the last header, flag, or body token ends it ("fails an info diagram that covers the line feed after its header", "fails an info diagram that ends before its last flag character", "fails an info diagram that ends before its last body token"); and ordinary comments outside it do not extend it ("fails an info diagram that covers its trailing native comment", "fails an info diagram that covers the comment before its first retained form").
